name: Rotate AWS VPN Key Monthly
description: Changes the pre-shared key between AWS and the lab edge router in place, only with the tunnel up: a new key in Vault and Secrets Manager, strongSwan reloads it, the router takes it under a revert timer and saves it, Vault keeps two versions, then Verify's checks. When the router does not take it the AWS side goes back to the previous key by itself; a failure opens a Work Center task (R4, ADR 0068). Run every day by a schedule; it rotates on the 1st of the month (UTC) only
